If you wish to appeal any deci  sion of the Planning Commission, you must do so within
15 days of the Planning Commission action. Please contact the Community

challenge any action of the Planning Commission in court, you may be limited to

this notice, or in written correspondence delivered to the Planning Commission at, or
prior to, the public hearing.
